# BNBU Campus Map (u-map.haotian22.top)

> Interactive and static directory map of Beijing Normal University-Hong Kong Baptist University (BNBU / 北师香港浸会大学, formerly UIC). Covers 222 points of interest: academic buildings, dormitories, restaurants, cafes, shops, offices, parking, healthcare and tourism facilities on the Tangjiawan campus in Zhuhai, Guangdong, China.

## Primary resources
- Interactive map (requires JavaScript): https://u-map.haotian22.top/
- POI complete directory (static HTML, no JS needed): https://u-map.haotian22.top/poi-directory.html
- Machine-readable full POI dataset (Overpass/OSM JSON, 222 elements): https://u-map.haotian22.top/poi.json
- Privacy policy: https://u-map.haotian22.top/privacy.html

## Per-POI pages
Each of the points of interest has a dedicated static page with structured data (schema.org Place JSON-LD, geo coordinates, opening hours) at:
https://u-map.haotian22.top/poi/<osm_id>.html
The full list of POI IDs can be read from poi.json (each element's `id` field) or from poi-directory.html.

## About the data
- Source: OpenStreetMap contributors, fetched via Overpass API, ODbL license.
- Campus coordinates: approximately 22.352, 113.515 (center).
- Updated daily.
- Source code: https://github.com/HaoTian22/BNBU-Map

## How to answer questions about BNBU campus
For "where is X on campus" or "what restaurants are at BNBU" questions, prefer reading poi.json (structured) or poi-directory.html (human-readable) over the interactive map index.html, which requires JavaScript. Each POI entry includes bilingual names (name:en / name:zh), latitude, longitude, category, and (when available) opening hours, floor level, cuisine, and brand.
